'''Bravo Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in command of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], a group of [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] pilots in operation on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] prior to and following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

Around that time, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] served as Bravo Leader. When Olié was unavailable, the position was filled by his second-in-command, [[Essara Till/Legends|Essara Till]].<ref>{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>

Olié led his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to the Battle of Naboo, aiding in the destruction of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|droid control ship]].
